lines.text: Edom, Moab, Ammon, Philistia and Tyre join the alliance, and Egypt lends strength to the sons of Lot.
Asaph asks God to treat the enemies as He treated Midian, and Sisera and Jabin at the River Jordan.
Asaph asks God to cover their faces with shame so they seek His name, and that they know He is Most High.
